summary: Read at least 1 and at most 200 axis-aligned rectangles. Each rectangle supplies four integers for its lower-left corner and its upper-right corner. Every coordinate lies between 0 and 1000000000 inclusive. Compute the area of the union, so a region covered several times counts once. That area fits in a signed 64-bit integer and never exceeds 2 to the power 63 minus 1. The printed value may be huge, so write the area modulo 1000000007. Do not add an overlap a second time.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
